correction_reason: Correct the ELOC Form 8-K URL to the issuer's actual evernorth-elocx8xk.htm primary filing.
Correct the public-warrant prospectus URL and its prospectus date.
Correct the EFFECT date for registration 333-294417 to 2026-08-27; it is not an ELOC registration.

warrant_prospectus.normalized_excerpt: Evernorth prospectus supplement dated 2026-10-09 under Registration No. 333-294417 covers 11,499,992 public warrants. The company receives proceeds only if warrants are exercised for cash. Each Pubco Warrant is exercisable for one Class A share at $11.50, commencing 12 months after the October 9, 2026 business-combination closing; earliest contractual commencement is approximately 2027-10-09, subject to the warrant agreement and other conditions.

registration_disambiguation.normalized_excerpt: SEC EDGAR EFFECT filing for Evernorth file number 333-294417 shows effectiveness date 2026-08-27. That registration relates to the public-warrant share registration. The separate ELOC resale prospectus is filed under registration number 333-299620 and dated 2026-10-30. Do not attribute the 333-294417 EFFECT date to the ELOC.

in_kind_breakdown.normalized_excerpt: The SEC prospectus describes XRP contributions of 126,791,458 XRP from Ripple; 600,000 XRP from Advance Funding Subscribers; 200,000 XRP from Delayed Funding Subscribers; 211,319,096.061435 XRP through the Series C Subscription; and 50,000,000 XRP from the Contributor Related Party Entity. These sum to 388,910,554.061435 XRP, reported in rounded form as approximately 388,910,554 XRP. The 261,919,096 XRP 'Pubco XRP' subtotal is 600,000 + 211,319,096 + 50,000,000 and is not the full in-kind total.

registration_statement_disambiguation.warning: The 333-294417 EFFECT applies to the public-warrant registration. It is not the ELOC registration.

public_warrants_correction.interpretation: The $132.25M is a future conditional maximum, not current or realized capital. The warrants were not yet contractually exercisable as of 2026-11-06.

in_kind_contribution_reconciliation.distinction: The 261,919,096 Pubco XRP subtotal is not the full 388,910,554 in-kind total; Ripple's 126,791,458 and delayed-funding 200,000 XRP are separate components.
